name: motion-ease-house
title: Thin-peak (House curve)
description: Dồn chậm, vụt qua giữa rồi đáp mềm; đường cong nền để tránh tốc độ đều đều.inOut).

moworks.author: moworks

options.graph: a canvas to draw the curve on (a teaching guide; none by default)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Target moves 0 → 100 % on cubic-bezier(.83,0,.17,1) (≈ power4.inOut, quint in-out), 600 ms: a slow wind-up, a thin fast peak in the middle, a soft landing. Rule: the base curve against monotonous speed. Small demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.6 s) · ease (custom .83,0,.17,1).
